messages:
Maya P: Hey — hitting a weird failure on the node quickstart. First call keeps timing out / eventually 504 from the SDK. Using workspace 'redwood-team', REDWOOD_API_KEY set in my shell. Anyone seen this recently?

Liam K: Are you behind corp VPN or a proxy? we've had timeouts when the proxy closes idle connections to the api gateway.

Maya P: Not on VPN. Reproduced with curl too: I get a 502 then SDK tries retries and returns 504. Log snippet: 
```
$ curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/llm/generate
* Connected to api.redwood.ai (52.12.34.56) port 443 (#0)
> GET /v1/llm/generate HTTP/1.1
> Host: api.redwood.ai
> Authorization: Bearer 
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< content-type: application/json
< {"error":"upstream connect error or disconnect"}
```

Andrew S: Two quick things to check: 1) billing state for your workspace (new orgs sometimes have a "pending" status that affects first-call routing), 2) whether the value of REDWOOD_API_KEY is actually set in the process running the curl/SDK.

Maya P: Billing UI shows "trial pending" but not an explicit block. I can paste the header from the container if that helps.

devex-bot: FYI — newly created workspaces via SSO may require a payment method attachment before we route to hosted capacity; the onboarding flow should surface that but in some edge cases it doesn't. Ticket #IN-423 created.

Liam K: Also, small gotcha: when running the sample docker image, env vars in your local shell are not automatically passed into the container unless you use --env-file or -e. I hit this yesterday.

Maya P: Good call — I was running the docker quickstart. I accidentally started the container without --env-file. Header was missing the token (hence Authorization: Bearer ). Fixing and re-running now.

Maya P: OK re-ran with correct env, first call succeeded (200) and response tokens streaming. :tada:

Andrew S: Great — thanks for following up. We'll add a clearer note in the quickstart about the docker env gotcha and flag the billing edge case in the onboarding checklist.

Liam K: Can you drop the exact docker command you used? we can paste it into the quickstart PR.

Maya P: Sure — `docker run --rm --env-file .env redwood/quickstart:latest node app.js`. Will open a tiny PR with that command and a note about checking the workspace billing status.

devex-bot: Linked issue: DOCS-781 (add docker env note) and IN-423 (onboarding billing).
